title: Return contract as a round contract
statement: Given a $k$-tape machine, an anchor state, an index type, an input word, and a return contract for that machine and anchor, the associated round contract has the same precondition, running time, endpoint, and work-head bounds. For every eligible start configuration, its run takes positive time, returns to the anchor, avoids both the anchor and halting state at every strictly intermediate positive time, and keeps every work-head position within the specified bounds throughout the run.
